scripts.lint: npm run oxlint && npm run stylelint
scripts.check:workbench: npm run typecheck && oxfmt -c oxfmt.config.mjs --check "src/pages/composition-workbench/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && oxlint -c oxlint.config.mjs src/pages/composition-workbench && stylelint "src/pages/composition-workbench/**/*.css" --cache && vitest run src/pages/composition-workbench
scripts.check:hfl: npm run typecheck && oxfmt -c oxfmt.config.mjs --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "src/lib/harmonic-field/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "src/pages/harmonic-field-lab/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && oxlint -c oxlint.config.mjs --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src/lib/harmonic-field src/pages/harmonic-field-lab && stylelint "src/pages/harmonic-field-lab/**/*.css" --cache --allow-empty-input && vitest run --passWithNoTests src/lib/harmonic-field src/pages/harmonic-field-lab
scripts.check:stage: npm run typecheck && oxfmt -c oxfmt.config.mjs --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "src/lib/stage/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "src/pages/stage/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && oxlint -c oxlint.config.mjs --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src/lib/stage src/pages/stage && stylelint "src/pages/stage/**/*.css" --cache --allow-empty-input && vitest run --passWithNoTests src/lib/stage src/pages/stage
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run format:test && npm run lint && npm run vitest && npm run build
